about.what_this_is: Opportunities for a student opportunity-finder app, organized into three tabs: School, Community and Explore.
about.how_to_use: Each opportunity is one object. Use 'scope' for the tab. 'status' plus 'status_meaning' explains availability. Fields marked in 'notes' need a check before launch.
about.match_level: Not stored in this file. The app should compute a 1-10 score per student by comparing quiz answers to 'tags' and 'good_fit_if_you_are'.

quiz_to_field_mapping.What school do you go to?: school (School tab shows that school's opportunities)
quiz_to_field_mapping.Anything you definitely don't want to do: compare against tags; push matches down

status_meanings.Open to new members: No application. Just show up or sign up.
status_meanings.Contact sponsor to join: Message the sponsor or student leaders to get in.
status_meanings.Application required: You must apply or be accepted before joining.
status_meanings.Pending approval (not meeting yet): School has not approved it yet. Hidden from the ranked list by default.
status_meanings.Info needed: School sheet is missing key details. Hidden from the ranked list by default.
status_meanings.Seasonal: check dates: Runs on a yearly cycle. Check the program site for this year's dates.
status_meanings.Closed (reopens next cycle): This year's round is over. Shows the next expected opening.
status_meanings.Opens later (applications seasonal): Not open right now. Expected to open at the time listed.
status_meanings.Waiver required: Sign a safety waiver before attending.
